cards.body:
WAIT WHAT!? 😨

Nobody told you this about bad breath. Until now 👇
There's something no one talks about. 

Inside your mouth, things like food debris and proteins collect on your tongue, cheeks, and gum line. You may not see them. You may not feel them. 👀
But odour causing bacteria could be feeding off them. And when bacteria eat, they release sulfur waste.
Sulfur smells like rotten eggs or garlic. Which can be the smell people are trying to get rid of. 🥚

That could also be why you wake up with bad breath.
Brushing helps teeth. Tongue scraping helps a bit too. 🪥

But oral rinses are able to target hard to reach and soft tissue areas in the mouth - which might be where this leftover residue is hiding.

And here's why this one is different ⬇️
This is ID Stain Whitening Mouthwash.

It's designed to reveal oral debris, clumping them together, pulling them into visible particles you can see when you spit the mouthwash out. 😳
And yes, the first time you use it, you might be shocked by what comes out.

That's not the mouthwash. That was already in your mouth.

Here's the bonus ✨

The cleaner your mouth is, the better whitening ingredients work.

This mouthwash includes hydrogen peroxide, which can help maintain your white teeth. 🤍

Most people start using it for a fresher breath. They keep using it because they can actually feel the difference. 💪
Links below - they have sold out before so be quick. 🔗
